documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Canarys Automations reported its highest ever financial performance for FY26, crossing INR100 crores on a standalone basis and reaching close to INR200 crores on a consolidated basis. Management highlighted a strategic pivot toward becoming an AI-native engineering and solution resilience platform, driven by their proprietary CAR framework and AI-powered products like AURYIS, ClubAce, and Scholaris. The company also integrated Fortira Inc. during the year to expand its North American presence and capabilities. Management expects improved EBITDA and PAT margins over the next 12 to 24 months, supported by agentic AI adoption, product revenue scaling, and operating leverage.

guidance.claim: Management targets a bare minimum revenue growth of 20% for the next two years while aiming for higher growth.
guidance.quote: It should be. We are targeting a little higher as well. But at a bare minimum, yes, 20% is quite achievable, but we are targeting for higher growth.

guidance.claim: Management targets crossing 50% plus on the export business.
guidance.quote: So the target is to cross 50% plus on the export business and have a similar business in the India region.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the current pipeline is pretty strong with multiple project opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Pipeline is pretty strong. We are working on multiple project opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that customers are asking for quick turnaround because they feel AI is the norm.
demand_outlook.quote: A lot of customers are also asking quick turnaround because they all feel that AI is the norm, and we cannot avoid that.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025, significantly strengthening Canarys' presence in the North American technology services market.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated margins moderated during the year due to strategic investments in talent, technology, and the integration of Fortira.
margins_costs.quote: while consolidated margins moderated during the year, this was a conscious outcome of our strategic investments in talent, technology and integration of Fortira.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects agentic AI adoption to realize up to a 12 percentage point gross margin potential.
margins_costs.quote: First, as agentic AI adoption scales across our delivery model through the CAR framework, we expect to realize much of the up to 12% point gross margin potential we have already identified, converting engineering productivity gains directly into the bottom line.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA margin improved to 17% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Margin improved to 17% through operational efficiencies, execution excellence, and AI-enabled productivity initiatives.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins moderated due to strategic growth investments, integration costs, and talent onboarding.
margins_costs.quote: Strategic growth investments, including integration costs and talent onboarding, led to a moderation in EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: There is a slight dip in margin, which was expected as we made strategic investments in team expansion, product development, and global scaling.
margins_costs.quote: There is a slight dip in margin, which was expected as we made strategic investments in team expansion, product development, and global scaling.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book stands at approximately INR441 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at approximately INR441 crores, giving us healthy revenue visibility for the years ahead.

orders_capacity.claim: Technology Solutions contributes INR206 crores to the order book, while Fortira adds INR207 crores and Water Resource Management contributes INR28 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Technology Solutions contributes INR206 crores, nearly doubling from INR105 crores in FY '25. Fortira adds INR207 crores and Water Resource Management contributes INR28 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Management states the total order book stands at around INR440 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: The total order book stands at around INR440 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Our order book now stands at a healthy INR 208 crores, out of which INR 151 crores from technology solutions vertical, a significant rise from INR 105 crores in FY '25, and INR 57 crores from water resource management.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book now stands at a healthy INR 208 crores, out of which INR 151 crores from technology solutions vertical, a significant rise from INR 105 crores in FY '25, and INR 57 crores from water resource management.

capital_allocation.claim: Our debt-to-equity ratio remains very low at 0.1x, underlying our conservative and healthy capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt-to-equity ratio remains very low at 0.1x, underlying our conservative and healthy capital structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Growth in profit after tax was affected by a onetime exceptional item relating to the implementation of labour code provisions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR10 crores. Growth here was affected by a onetime exceptional item relating to the implementation of labour code provisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Standalone PAT growth was affected by a one-time exceptional loss related to labour code implementation.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, PAT growth was affected by a one-time exceptional loss related to the implementation of labour code provisions.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects margin correction and building traction for Fortira to take 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: The correction will definitely take about 12 to 18 months. And Fortira has already seen good traction with this.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects profitability and margin improvements to show over the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Put simply, we are deliberately pivoting our business model through AI and our product portfolio toward a structurally high margin, more profitable and faster-growing company, and we expect the numbers to show it over the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: One of our key goals for FY '26 is to train 25% of our team in AI, ML, and data skills to strengthen our leadership in emerging technologies.
management_commitments.quote: One of our key goals for FY '26 is to train 25% of our team in AI, ML, and data skills to strengthen our leadership in emerging technologies.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
